title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-11
lineage: aud>?>7" reel @ 3.75 ips, no nr technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96>cd wave>adobe audition 2.0>flac; patched/seeded by Rob Berger 2011-03-03

ai_review.summary: Fantastic setlist hampered by a half‑step low pitch on the first set and terrible tape cuts, with a soundboard source that falls short technically.
ai_review.review: The show’s repertoire is highly praised – fans say they’d "die for a show like this" – but the recording suffers from serious pitch problems (about a half‑step flat in the first set) and frequent tape stops that make listening difficult. It appears to be a soundboard capture, yet the technical flaws outweigh the musical strengths, resulting in a mixed overall experience.

ai_rating.rationale: The setlist is lauded (strong show quality) but recording issues are severe (poor technical quality). With the show weighted more heavily, the combined assessment lands in the low‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First set pitched about a half‑step low; second set pitch improves but contains terrible cuts and tape machine stops, making portions unintelligible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist is considered excellent and highly desirable by reviewers, though no specific song comments are provided; overall flow praised but marred by recording flaws.
